item.title: Ian Bremmer: The US–China AI space has “Zero Trust”
item.description: China was largely absent from the core conversations at the 2026 Munich Security Conference. That, says Ian Bremmer, is telling. item.title: Two Americas on display in Munich
item.description: For decades, the Munich Security Conference has functioned as the annual “family reunion” of the transatlantic alliance – a place where American and European leaders and diplomats come together to discuss international security. Since 1963, it’s revolved around a core assumption: the relationship between the United States and Europe is durable within a US-led global order, even when tested.
